finalText:
**Migrated 12 files, 36 call sites.** All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Two calls in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still use the old form. That file says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. Your call whether to patch upstream or wrap it.

`cache.query` is a different thing. I left it alone.

Node parses all 12 files fine. There are no tests here to run.
